title: Thick isomorphism locus of an exact contravariant transformation
statement: Let C,D be pretriangulated categories [def-weil-triangulated-category] with additive integer shifts. Let B,E:C^op->D be triangulated functors and beta:B->E a natural transformation commuting with integer shifts. Then the object property P(K):=IsIso(beta_K) on C is triangulated and stable under retracts.

source.place: Tags 08J9 and 08JC; signed internal Hom and its evaluation transpose, as expanded in steps 1--6 of lem-sf-site-hom-comparison-thick.

proof.text: Zero maps between zero objects are invertible. The shift square transports invertibility. Apply the induced triangle morphism to the reversed distinguished triangle; its first and third components force the middle component invertible.

proof.text: Naturality makes beta at a retract a retract in the arrow category. Isomorphisms are stable under such retracts, proving retract closure and closure under isomorphisms.
